translation: It grows on Jingshan. The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 楝實 (liànshí), flavor bitter, cold. It governs warm disease and cold-damage (溫疾傷寒), great heat, mania and vexation (大熱煩狂), kills the three worms (殺三蟲), scabies and ulcers (疥瘍), and benefits urination and the water passage (利小便水道).
